title: Width bound preserved under concatenating families of formulas
statement: Let $g_1$ and $g_2$ be two families of DNF formulas over $n$ variables, indexed respectively by $m_1$ and $m_2$ positions, and let $l$ be a natural number. Suppose every formula in $g_1$ and every formula in $g_2$ has width at most $l$. Then every formula in the merged family of $m_1 + m_2$ formulas — those of $g_1$ in order, followed by those of $g_2$ — also has width at most $l$.
hypotheses_covered: g₁ is a family of m₁ DNF formulas over n variables
g₂ is a family of m₂ DNF formulas over n variables
l is a natural number bound
every formula in g₁ has width ≤ l
every formula in g₂ has width ≤ l
conclusion holds for every index of the merged family of size m₁ + m₂
replaced:
If every gate of $g_1$ and every gate of $g_2$ has width at most $l$, then every gate of
the merged array $\mathrm{mergeGates}\,g_1\,g_2$ has width at most $l$.
